_help: Bug Understanding Model (written by ba-bug-investigator). claims[].classification: VERIFIED_OBSERVATION|AUTHORITATIVE_REQUIREMENT|REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE|CORROBORATED_INFERENCE|UNVERIFIED_ASSUMPTION|CONTRADICTION|UNKNOWN. AUTHORITATIVE_REQUIREMENT claims need source_path + verbatim quote (checked against the file) or answer_ref (an AUTHORIZED answer id). hypotheses[].status: CANDIDATE|SUPPORTED|CONFIRMED|REFUTED; evidence kinds reproduction|test|trace|log|debugger|experiment count as direct evidence; refs under evidence/ must exist in the run dir. root_cause.status: CONFIRMED|PROBABLE|UNCONFIRMED (the latter two need diagnostic_limitation).
